name: tg-account-mcp
description: Connect Codex to a self-hosted multi-account Telegram MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Work with Telegram accounts and bots from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to TG Account MCP and provides reliable workflows for finding chats, reading folders and history, handling attachments, drafting replies, and sending through an explicitly selected Telegram identity.
defaultPrompt: Summarize today's messages in one Telegram folder.
Find a Telegram chat and recap a date range.
Draft a Telegram reply for my review.
